jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Hey, we're Sparta Commodities!

We are a Swiss, VC-backed scaleup with a global reach. Our mission is to digitize the commodity trading market and become the leading platform for traders in all commodities verticals. We've already gained significant market traction and are financially backed by Venture Investors.

We have a fantastic opportunity available for a driven and passionate Frontend Engineer to join our growing Engineering team, based remotely in Spain. This is a great career opportunity for an experienced and delivery-focused Engineer to play a key role in the development and maintenance of various front-end systems, including an Excel plug in, for a leading and highly regarded business. About The Team Our naturally diverse teams are divided into verticals, with a mix of multidisciplinary members. Each team has at least 3 Backend Engineers, 3 Frontend Engineers, a Designer, a QA Engineer, a Product Owner, and a Team Manager. We work on bi-weekly sprints with quarterly goals... Each project is kicked off by a product request, from which we build a technical proposal that is refined within the team. Once the project has been greenlit one team member becomes its owner. An owner follows the project through development and deployment, making the other team member accountable for their responsibilities. About The Tech We have a modern React website built using the latest Vite, using libraries such as Redux and SWR. Our Components are designed around Material UI and styled with SASS. We have plenty of financial data to graph in charts, for which we have extended chartjs. Our designers share Figma wireframes with beautiful adaptive designs. But our use of web technologies isn't limited to frontend. We share parts of our code with a Node backend. And we've also ventured into using TypeScript to develop Excel Add-Ins. In 2023 we doubled our website's screen count, with intentions to sextuple it by late 2024. We will also start serving content dynamically per customer, migrating from the unified experience we have today. About You We are looking for someone who has had ownership of projects from inception until after release, and who is familiar with observability, product metrics, and maintainability. They will be involved in the design of technical solutions as owner and implementor, on top of reviewing designs from other team members. On your day-to-day, you will work within the team reviewing code, and promoting initiatives to improve our code quality, maintainability, and development experience. As part of the development sprints, you will release new features and products using quality practices such as automated testing, QA validation, and monitorization. Requirements Ownership and accountability for projects and their product metrics Prior work in dashboards and/or customizable UI experiences Experience with Jest, Mocha or other common testing libs High communication skills in a remote-first company with a diverse workforce Bonus Points Knowledge of server-side rendering techniques and architectures Extensive experience with NextJS, Remix, Astro or similar A body of work in modular Design Systems Experience with cypress for e2e tests Prior work on real-time systems such as WebSockets, stock tickers, or videogames Experience and prior work with Redux What's the culture like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is not just a set of values written on a wall—it's a way of life. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives.

We're building an environment where our employees thrive and excel in their work. Our aim is for every member of our team to take pride in their contributions. You'll collaborate with like-minded individuals who are passionate about our mission and deeply committed to crafting outstanding products and achieving success for our customers.

We operate remotely, understanding that a thriving, profitable company isn't just about being in the same location. We build our relationships through effective remote work methods and carefully planned in-person meet-ups.

What We Offer

Remote working, with occasional travel to a central hub for collaborative meetings and coordination.

Attractive company stock option plan.

Yearly companywide meet-ups in sunny locations.

Training and education budget.

Private Medical Insurance. Access to the optimal gear suited for your position.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. As an international business, we are determined that suitably qualified persons will never receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. *Note for agencies- Please do not call or email any member of the Sparta team. All correspondence regarding interest in future partnerships should be directed to ******. Thank you for your understanding* #J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.description:
Hey, we're Sparta Commodities!

We are a Swiss, VC-backed scaleup with a global reach. Our mission is to digitize the commodity trading market and become the leading platform for traders in all commodities verticals. We've already gained significant market traction and are financially backed by Venture Investors.

We have a fantastic opportunity available for a driven and passionate Frontend Engineer to join our growing Engineering team, based remotely in Spain. This is a great career opportunity for an experienced and delivery-focused Engineer to play a key role in the development and maintenance of various front-end systems, including an Excel plug in, for a leading and highly regarded business.

About The Team

Our naturally diverse teams are divided into verticals, with a mix of multidisciplinary members. Each team has at least 3 Backend Engineers, 3 Frontend Engineers, a Designer, a QA Engineer, a Product Owner, and a Team Manager. We work on bi-weekly sprints with quarterly... goals. Each project is kicked off by a product request, from which we build a technical proposal that is refined within the team. Once the project has been greenlit one team member becomes its owner. An owner follows the project through development and deployment, making the other team member accountable for their responsibilities.

About The Tech

We have a modern React website built using the latest Vite, using libraries such as Redux and SWR. Our Components are designed around Material UI and styled with SASS. We have plenty of financial data to graph in charts, for which we have extended chartjs. Our designers share Figma wireframes with beautiful adaptive designs.

But our use of web technologies isn't limited to frontend. We share parts of our code with a Node backend. And we've also ventured into using TypeScript to develop Excel Add-Ins.

In 2023 we doubled our website's screen count, with intentions to sextuple it by late 2024. We will also start serving content dynamically per customer, migrating from the unified experience we have today.

About You

We are looking for someone who has had ownership of projects from inception until after release, and who is familiar with observability, product metrics, and maintainability. They will be involved in the design of technical solutions as owner and implementor, on top of reviewing designs from other team members.

On your day-to-day, you will work within the team reviewing code, and promoting initiatives to improve our code quality, maintainability, and development experience. As part of the development sprints, you will release new features and products using quality practices such as automated testing, QA validation, and monitorization.

Requirements
• Ownership and accountability for projects and their product metrics
• Prior work in dashboards and/or customizable UI experiences
• Experience with Jest, Mocha or other common testing libs
• High communication skills in a remote-first company with a diverse workforce

Bonus Points
• Knowledge of server-side rendering techniques and architectures
• Extensive experience with NextJS, Remix, Astro or similar
• A body of work in modular Design Systems
• Experience with cypress for e2e tests
• Prior work on real-time systems such as WebSockets, stock tickers, or videogames
• Experience and prior work with Redux

What's the culture like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is not just a set of values written on a wall—it's a way of life. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives.

We're building an environment where our employees thrive and excel in their work. Our aim is for every member of our team to take pride in their contributions. You'll collaborate with like-minded individuals who are passionate about our mission and deeply committed to crafting outstanding products and achieving success for our customers.

We operate remotely, understanding that a thriving, profitable company isn't just about being in the same location. We build our relationships through effective remote work methods and carefully planned in-person meet-ups.

What we offer:
• Remote working, with occasional travel to a central hub for collaborative meetings and coordination.
• Attractive company stock option plan.
• Yearly companywide meet-ups in sunny locations.
• Training and education budget.
• Private Medical Insurance
• Access to the optimal gear suited for your position.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. As an international business, we are determined that suitably qualified persons will never receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law.
• Note for agencies- Please do not call or email any member of the Sparta team. All correspondence regarding interest in future partnerships should be directed to careers@spartacommodities.com. Thank you for your understanding

jobs_results.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Frontend Engineer @ Embat

Embat was born to design the best way for medium and large sized enterprises to plan their finances and monitor their cash flow in real time.

We are building a financial management platform that allows them to understand what has happened in the past, track what is happening today and forecast the future of their businesses.

Our mission is to build a product that leverages technology and excellent client experience to empower our clients to make the best business decisions by accessing the best financial information, 100x more efficiently than using Excel files.

Our solution translates into savings of up to 75% of the time that financial teams spend on manual tasks. This allows them to focus on what matters most: making a greater impact within their organization and achieving a better balance between personal and professional life.

Our platform is already the trusted treasury management software of a large number of medium and large-sized corporates in... Europe.

Composed of a fantastic team of people of 50+ members with different backgrounds and nationalities.

Backed by reputable international investors with the ambition to make Embat global and a great place to work! We are backed by top-tier international VCs.

In February 2024, we closed our third round of investment worth 15 million euros! This has been led by the renowned international investment fund Creandum, with the invaluable support of our partners Samaipata, 4Founders Capital, VentureFriends, Hugo Arévalo and Martin Blessing.

As a Frontend Engineer, you will work together with our development team, product managers, and designers. We pride ourselves on working in an evolving and agile environment, with day-to-day interaction with every member of the team. No bureaucracy or hierarchy. We rather give you space to build, to collaborate and to create value and direct impact to our users. We love to find team members that challenge and question the features they are working on.

Our Frontend is built with ReactJS. We use Figma to build our proprietary Design System and UI Kit. Our Backend runs on NodeJS and our platform on Google Cloud, it keeps us moving fast and scale up, but with strong resiliency.

What will you do?
• Work with an experienced development team and product managers to ideate, brainstorm and build impressive financial features. Code hard, think hard.
• Design, develop and maintain our APIs and web applications for maximum robustness, scalability and security.
• Test all new features and enhancements to ensure responsiveness and efficiency. This includes mastering troubleshooting, debugging and upgrades. We also need you to document your code to make sure the team is fully aligned.
• Help us protect our users' data, confidentiality and integrity by creating security and data protection settings.
• Help build CI/CD, monitoring and testing practices together with the rest of the team.
• Work in a comfortable and rewarding environment, making sure that the Embat culture and mission is safeguarded and spread.
• Be ready to develop skills and learn from other areas they might have expertise on.

What are we looking for?
• 5+ years of experience as a FullStack or Frontend engineer using Javascript/Typescript
• Experience in production environments using React is a must
• Strong knowledge of software architecture design patterns and coding best practices.
• You like taking responsibility, ownership and creating impact. We need builders and problem solvers who feel proud and liable for our success. Advocate a quality culture across the whole Embat organization.
• You are comfortable with testing environments and make sure every detail is brushed before going to production. You are passionate about high quality.
• You are highly organized and can adjust priorities, having great attention to detail. You understanding the difference between perfect and a good-enough result
• Team player: "We" is always before "I". We need versatility, humility, and team members that enjoy working and learning from each other.
• You are ambitious: curious to learn about new tools and getting to the bottom of each problem
• Background studies related to Computer Science
• Languages: Working proficiency in English & fluent in Spanish
• Location: preferably in Madrid or elsewhere in Spain

Additionally, any of the below would definitely be great:
• Familiarity with the rest of our tech stack: React, Redux, Storybook, NodeJS, Express, Cypress, Jest, MongoDB, Python, GCP, Gitlab CI/CD…
• Experience with CI/CD processes and DevOps practices.
• Knowledge of tracking test coverage tools and quality monitoring.
• Previous experience in the financial industry or fintechs.
• International experience and additional languages are key to embracing our inclusive culture.
• We love people that are opinionated and are not afraid of disagreeing.
• Collaboration in open-source projects

What comes with working at Embat?

We offer a platform that allows you to reach your professional and personal goals. We pride ourselves on working in an evolving and agile environment, with day-to-day interaction with every member of the team. No bureaucracy or hierarchy. We rather give you space to lead, build, collaborate and create value to our users.

Additionally, being an Embat(ier) also comes with the following benefits:
• A competitive salary according to the project and responsibility
• Hybrid working setup & flexible schedule
• Latest technology of your choice to do your impactful work with
• Access to private health insurance with Sanitas
• Access to salary on demand, restaurante card, transport card, and kindergarden checks through Payflow
• Career progression - we are a small team with great ambitions.
• An opportunity to work hand in hand with our founders who built their careers in Investment Banking at J.P. Morgan for more than a decade.
• Twice-yearly performance reviews
• 360º development - through internal and external talks, sponsored conferences and many more to come
• Fruit and coffee at the office!
• Team Buildings plans

Composed of a fantastic team of people of 50+ members with different backgrounds and nationalities.

Backed by reputable international investors with the ambition to make Embat global and a great place to work! We are backed by top-tier international VCs.

In February 2024, we closed our third round of investment worth 15 million euros! This has been led by the renowned international investment fund Creandum, with the invaluable support of our partners Samaipata, 4Founders Capital, VentureFriends, Hugo Arévalo and Martin Blessing.

As a Frontend Engineer, you will work together with our development team, product managers, and designers. We pride ourselves on working in an evolving and agile environment, with day-to-day interaction with every member of the team. No bureaucracy or hierarchy. We rather give you space to build, to collaborate and to create value and direct impact to our users. We love to find team members that challenge and question the features they are working on.

Our Frontend is built with ReactJS. We use Figma to build our proprietary Design System and UI Kit. Our Backend runs on NodeJS and our platform on Google Cloud, it keeps us moving fast and scale up, but with strong resiliency.

What will you do?
• Work with an experienced development team and product managers to ideate, brainstorm and build impressive financial features. Code hard, think hard.
• Design, develop and maintain our APIs and web applications for maximum robustness, scalability and security.
• Test all new features and enhancements to ensure responsiveness and efficiency. This includes mastering troubleshooting, debugging and upgrades. We also need you to document your code to make sure the team is fully aligned.
• Help us protect our users' data, confidentiality and integrity by creating security and data protection settings.
• Help build CI/CD, monitoring and testing practices together with the rest of the team.
• Work in a comfortable and rewarding environment, making sure that the Embat culture and mission is safeguarded and spread.
• Be ready to develop skills and learn from other areas they might have expertise on.

What are we looking for?
• 5+ years of experience as a FullStack or Frontend engineer using Javascript/Typescript
• Experience in production environments using React is a must
• Strong knowledge of software architecture design patterns and coding best practices.
• You like taking responsibility, ownership and creating impact. We need builders and problem solvers who feel proud and liable for our success. Advocate a quality culture across the whole Embat organization.
• You are comfortable with testing environments and make sure every detail is brushed before going to production. You are passionate about high quality.
• You are highly organized and can adjust priorities, having great attention to detail. You understanding the difference between perfect and a good-enough result
• Team player: "We" is always before "I". We need versatility, humility, and team members that enjoy working and learning from each other.
• You are ambitious: curious to learn about new tools and getting to the bottom of each problem
• Background studies related to Computer Science
• Languages: Working proficiency in English & fluent in Spanish
• Location: preferably in Madrid or elsewhere in Spain

Additionally, any of the below would definitely be great:
• Familiarity with the rest of our tech stack: React, Redux, Storybook, NodeJS, Express, Cypress, Jest, MongoDB, Python, GCP, Gitlab CI/CD…
• Experience with CI/CD processes and DevOps practices.
• Knowledge of tracking test coverage tools and quality monitoring.
• Previous experience in the financial industry or fintechs.
• International experience and additional languages are key to embracing our inclusive culture.
• We love people that are opinionated and are not afraid of disagreeing.
• Collaboration in open-source projects

What comes with working at Embat?

We offer a platform that allows you to reach your professional and personal goals. We pride ourselves on working in an evolving and agile environment, with day-to-day interaction with every member of the team. No bureaucracy or hierarchy. We rather give you space to lead, build, collaborate and create value to our users.

Additionally, being an Embat(ier) also comes with the following benefits:
• A competitive salary according to the project and responsibility
• Hybrid working setup & flexible schedule
• Latest technology of your choice to do your impactful work with
• Access to private health insurance with Sanitas
• Access to salary on demand, restaurante card, transport card, and kindergarden checks through Payflow
• Career progression - we are a small team with great ambitions.
• An opportunity to work hand in hand with our founders who built their careers in Investment Banking at J.P. Morgan for more than a decade.
• Twice-yearly performance reviews
• 360º development - through internal and external talks, sponsored conferences and many more to come
• Fruit and coffee at the office!
• Team Buildings plans

jobs_results.title: Angular Frontend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Share this job

We are looking for an experienced Angular Frontend Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing high-quality web applications using Angular and other modern web technologies. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining the frontend of our web applications, ensuring that they are fast, responsive, and user-friendly.

Responsibilities
• Design and develop dynamic, responsive web applications using Angular.
• Leverage a human-centered design process to deliver an easy-to-use user interface and user experience.
• Strong experience in Angular framework(14 and above), Bootstrap 4, CSS3, HTML5 and javascript.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers and backend developers, to deliver high-quality software solutions.
• Create reusable components and front-end libraries for future use.
• Optimize applications for maximum performance and scalability.
• Integrate front-end components with server-side... logic using RESTful APIs.
• Translate design wireframes and mockups into polished, interactive user interfaces.
• Conduct code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to best practices.
• Translate concepts into user flows, wireframes, mockups and prototypes that lead to intuitive user experiences.
• Facilitate the client’s product vision by researching, conceiving, sketching, prototyping and user-testing experiences for digital products.
• Search and correction of UI errors
• Ability to write code that will be compatible with different browsers.
• Stay updated on emerging trends and technologies in web development, particularly within the Angular ecosystem

Requirements
• Degree of Software Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent, with overall experience of 6-8 years.
• Proven experience as an Angular Senior Developer
• Strong proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript and relevant web technologies.
• Proficient with design tools such as Axure, Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
• Experience working with RESTful APIs and integrating front-end applications with backend services.
• Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and release management.
• Solid understanding of web standards and cross-browser compatibility.

Apply now

Location Madrid, Spain

Barcelona, Spain Job type Full time Experience Experienced Job function IT, Telecom & Internet Contract Regular Publication date 2024-03-22 Reference number R0045615

jobs_results.title: Angular Front-end Developer 2024
jobs_results.description:
Descripción

¡ÚNETE AL EQUIPO COMO FRONTEND ENGINEER!

¿Quieres formar parte de una organización que apuesta por cuidar de las personas y su crecimiento personal y profesional?

En Kairós DS estamos buscando nuevos profesionales con experiencia en el desarrollo con Angular para que se unan a nuestro equipo de Software Development. Buscamos perfiles senior, apasionados del clean code y el rendimiento.

Trabajamos en proyectos con las últimas tecnologías y versiones de Angular, y nos enfocamos siempre hacia buenas prácticas, realizando test unitarios en un entorno de integración continua con metodologías ágiles.

Nos encanta que nuestras compañeras y compañeros enseñen a los demás y puedan aprender de las personas más expertas, siempre en el mejor ambiente, tanto profesional como personal.

¿Quiénes somos?

Acompañamos a nuestros clientes en proyectos de transformación tecnológica y ágil. Trabajamos en equipos organizados por Capacidades y en squads multidisciplinares en proyectos muy... diversos (retail, investigación sanitaria, banca, seguridad, movilidad…).

Aunque hemos crecido mucho en el último año, no queremos olvidarnos de nuestra esencia, centrados siempre en las personas: hacemos seguimiento personal constante con el equipo técnico y de Talento. Además, apostamos siempre por la transparencia y la claridad.

Estamos en España, México y Perú. En Kairós DS encontrarás proyectos en los que podrás trabajar desde casa, ¡sin perder la cercanía con el resto del equipo!

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?

Somos empresa Great Place to Work desde 2019 gracias a nuestros valores, nuestra cultura y a los beneficios e iniciativas internas que lanzamos centradas en las personas. Este año hemos quedado en la posición 5º en nuestra categoría.

Por Ello, En Kairós DS Encontrarás
• Bolsa individual de formación de 1.750 euros, formación continua corporativa y certificaciones técnicas.
• Clases de inglés gratuitas, en grupos reducidos.
• 23 días de vacaciones, 24 y 31 de diciembre libres, 1 día para eventos y ¡3 días de libre conciliación!
• Posibilidad de trabajar desde casa.
• Disfrutar del verano con nuestra jornada reducida en agosto y horario intensivo todos los viernes del año.
• Retribución flexible a través de Cobee, para hacer uso en restauración, transporte público, formación y ticket guardería.
• Seguro médico con Cigna o Sanitas: nos preocupamos de tu salud física y mental.
• Acompañamiento psicológico continuo a través de nuestro programa Wellness 3.0 y mentoring técnico constante.
• Fortalecimiento de tu marca personal en eventos internos y externos.
• Formar parte de una gran comunidad y contar con el apoyo de personas increíbles y referentes dentro del sector.

Pero sobre todo... ser parte de una empresa donde se te escucha, se te cuida y donde intentamos hacer todo lo posible por cubrir tus necesidades y expectativas.

¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

En los primeros días…
• Asistirás a una sesión de onboarding, en la que conocerás todo sobre Kairós DS y las personas que pueden ayudarte, así como los procesos internos, y podrás hablar directamente con los Heads de tu Capacidad y conocerlos mejor.
• Tendrás oportunidad de preguntar cualquier duda de manera pública o privada para resolver cualquier cuestión que te plantees.
• Te familiarizaras con las diferentes herramientas internas.
• Recibirás tu equipo informático y, poco después, ¡tu kit de bienvenida con regalos Kairoseros!
• Conocerás a tu embajador o embajadora, tu apoyo en el cliente o espacio de trabajo en el que crecerás las primeras semanas.

A los 3 meses...
• Habrás tenido oportunidad de aterrizar poco a poco, conociendo mejor al equipo de trabajo interno o en el cliente en el que estés trabajando.
• Ya habrás recibido notificaciones y publicaciones de comunicación interna, que te habrán ayudado a generar vínculos con la compañía.
• Tendrás una sesión 1:1 con el equipo de Talento para saber cómo están yendo estos primero meses y seguir ayudándote en tu onboarding.
• Podrás asistir a algunas de nuestras meriendas virtuales o presenciales de equipo.

A los 6 meses...
• Habrás terminado tu onboarding y tu adaptación dentro de Kairós DS habrá llegado al 100% aportando todo tu talento y tu valor.
• Habrás tenido oportunidad de participar de manera activa o como asistente en diferentes eventos o formaciones que organizamos.
• A partir de ahora tendrás un seguimiento 1:1 cada 6 meses tanto con el equipo de Talento como con los Heads

jobs_results.title: FRONT-END DEVELOPERS
jobs_results.description:
Are you opened to new and exciting challenges? TMC is looking for Front-End Developers to join our Software Factory. Be part of our team whose culture celebrates collaboration, learning, constructive debate, innovation and creativity. Would you like to know more?

| Your challenges?

We are currently seeking flexible and fast-thinking Front-End Developers. We have open positions for you in New Zealand, Spain and Portugal. Would you like to be part of a world-class team developing innovative projects for International brand clients using the latest technology?

We focus on delivering quality work, supporting our customers and above all, attitude! That’s why we expect our people to feel at home in all areas of today’s development.

| What do we expect from you?

You have a BSc. or MSc. Degree in Computer Sciences, Informatics or related field required with 5+ years of experience in Front-End development. During your MSc. or through professional experience you have gained expertise in... one or more of the following topics:
• Experience reading, writing, reviewing Angular, JavaScript and/or TypeScript code.
• Consolidated knowledge in modern frameworks such as React and Angular
• Experience with the most popular open-source mobile application framework in order to build mobile applications (React Native)
• Worked on products rather than just in projects. You understand market success, customer satisfaction and aim everything towards it.
• Familiarity with Agile development frameworks, e.g. Scrum
• Fluent in English is essential

| What does our Business Cell have to offer?

Be part of the TMC Software Factory, our Development Center that provides IT expertise and development based on best practices and accumulated experience to all our clients. We excel in agile development and IT engineering.

Who we are?
• High Performance Development Center
